In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, in the present study we have examined the structural features, electronic features, and energetics of cysteine metal complexes with Li+ Na + K+ Be2 + Mg2 + and Ca2 + cationic metal ions.
the interaction of cysteine molecules with Li+ Na+, K+ Be2+, Mg2+ and, Ca2+ metal ions are mainly governed by electrostatic forces and the nature of interaction is found to be ionic.
all the metal cations have a strong binding with cysteine, and the metal ion affinates of the metal cation complexes with cysteine are in the order of Li+ Na K+ Be2 Mg2 Ca2.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the coordination properties of cysteine towards Li+, Na+, K+, Mg2+, and Ca2+ ions are similar to those observed for cysteine complexes with other metal ions.
, the metal cations have a significant influence on the electronic structure, vibrational modes and the energetic features of cysteine.

the coordination geometries, the electronic features, metal cation affinities, the entropies, as well as the energetics for the Li+, Na+, K+, Be2+, Mg2+ and the Ca2+ metal ion complexes with different possible conformers of cysteine have been studied in the present work.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, the metal cation interaction with the thiol group of cysteine molecule is more pronounced than the metal cation interactions with other nucleophilic sites.
the metal cation affinity of cysteine depends on the nature of the metal cation, the binding site of the cysteine molecule, and the conformation of the molecule.

the metal ions Li+ Na+ Mg2+ Ca2+ and K+ have different binding affinities with cysteine, which can be explained in terms of the electrostatic potential of the metal cation and the charge distribution on the cysteine molecule.
